title: Case
description: The final auditable output: hypothesis, amount, supporting evidence, discarded leads, and limitations. See docs/contracts/case.md and docs/demo/runbook.md.

status.description: Never just 'suspicious' — the system must commit to one of these three, with reasoning.

limitations.description: What evidence is missing / what would change the conclusion — must be answerable at demo time (docs/demo/runbook.md step 12).

citations.description: Regulatory or rule references backing the conclusion, e.g. 'CFF Art. 69-B'.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical serialization, for optional Solana notarization (ADR-0004).
